reason: A DSH interface and desktop enhancement that migrates Codex pet skins and displays an animated pet reflecting agent and session activity, with configurable persistence and optional Electron rendering.

summaries.zh: 将 Codex 桌宠皮肤迁移到 DSH，并在网页或独立桌面窗口中显示可响应会话状态的动画桌宠。
summaries.en: Migrates Codex pet skins to DSH and displays an animated pet that responds to session activity in the web interface or an optional desktop window.

capabilities: Scans local Codex skin directories for pet.json and spritesheet.webp files
Copies discovered skin assets into the DSH home directory
Renders an animated desktop pet and per-session status dialogs in the DSH web interface
Provides an optional Electron desktop window with persistence, always-on-top, click-through, and context-menu controls
Reads DSH agent and session events to update pet animations and statuses
Persists pet and window settings in local DSH configuration files
Provides a UI action to terminate an active conversation
